anchors.quote: settlement is neither planned nor likely to occur in the foreseeable future
anchors.local_interpretation: Net-investment condition; not an optional presentation election

anchors.quote: They do not include trade receivables or trade payables.
anchors.local_interpretation: A trade balance cannot qualify merely because repayment is delayed

anchors.quote: may be any subsidiary of the group.
anchors.local_interpretation: The lending group entity need not be the parent; the example selects the parent

anchors.quote: foreign currency monetary items shall be translated using the closing rate;
anchors.local_interpretation: Parent EUR monetary receivable uses USD per EUR closing rate

anchors.quote: The carrying amount of an item is determined in conjunction with other relevant standards.
anchors.local_interpretation: Given carrying amount is a scoped input, not an initial-measurement rule

anchors.quote: shall be recognised in profit or loss in the period in which they arise, except as described in paragraph 32.
anchors.local_interpretation: Default exchange-difference presentation subject to the specific exception

anchors.quote: shall be recognised in profit or loss in the separate financial statements of the reporting entity
anchors.local_interpretation: Net-investment condition does not move parent separate gain to OCI

anchors.quote: such exchange differences shall be recognised initially in other comprehensive income and reclassified from equity to profit or loss on disposal
anchors.local_interpretation: Group presentation differs; disposal follows paragraph 48, not loan maturity alone

anchors.quote: If such an item is denominated in the functional currency of the foreign operation, an exchange difference arises in the reporting entity
anchors.local_interpretation: EUR denomination creates parent-side FX in the selected USD/EUR case

anchors.quote: assets and liabilities for each statement of financial position presented (ie including comparatives) shall be translated at the closing rate
anchors.local_interpretation: Translate subsidiary cash and payable together

anchors.quote: all resulting exchange differences shall be recognised in other comprehensive income.
anchors.local_interpretation: Ordinary subsidiary net-asset translation component is OCI

anchors.quote: cannot be eliminated against the corresponding intragroup liability (or asset) without showing the results of currency fluctuations
anchors.local_interpretation: Eliminating intragroup balance does not erase the exchange result

anchors.quote: IAS 12 Income Taxes applies to these tax effects.
anchors.local_interpretation: Tax omitted from the authored FX-only step, not declared nonexistent in real cases

anchors.quote: Unrealised gains and losses arising from changes in foreign currency exchange rates are not cash flows.
anchors.local_interpretation: Cash-value movement is not a receipt

anchors.quote: This amount is presented separately from cash flows from operating, investing and financing activities
anchors.local_interpretation: Separate exchange effect reconciles group cash

anchors.quote: eliminate in full intragroup assets and liabilities, equity, income, expenses and cash flows relating to
anchors.local_interpretation: Consolidation removes loan balances and parent investment against subsidiary equity
